headlines.title: Ground stop lifted: Bay Area airports impacted, what happens next?
headlines.description: Cross examination of the government’s key witness in the federal corruption trial of former Oakland Mayor Sheng Thao continued Friday. The cross examination included a fiery exchange between businessman Mario Juarez and Thao’s attorney, Jeffrey Tsai. Tsai zeroed in on texts around the time the alleged pay for play deal went south between Juarez and Thao’s co-defendant Andy Duong. The attorney even went as far as questioning whether any bribery scheme ever existed. Juarez fired back, pointing to recordings and saying “It was all verified. Listen to your lying ears.” Prosecutors allege Thao, her longtime partner Andre Jones, and two Oakland businessmen — Andy Duong and David Duong, traded cash and campaign support for political favors and city contracts. Juarez, who has pleaded guilty related to the alleged bribery scandal in exchange for a plea deal, also apologized in court, saying he let a lot of people down. Sheng Thao Nov 12 Sheng Thao Nov 6 Sheng Thao Oct 29 Former Oakland city employees testify in Sheng Thao corruption trial
